name: Delta Chat
description: OpenClaw channel plugin for Delta Chat messaging

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Delta Chat channel

email.description: Email address for the bot. Use 'auto' to create a chatmail account automatically

password.description: Password for the email account. Required when email is not 'auto'

chatmailServer.description: Chatmail server for auto-created accounts. Only used when email is 'auto' or not set

customChatmailRelay.description: Custom chatmail relay configuration for private/self-hosted chatmail servers

url.description: Full URL to the chatmail account creation endpoint (e.g., https://chatmail.example.com/new)

token.description: Optional authentication token for the chatmail server

dataDir.description: Directory for Delta Chat account data (keys, messages, etc.)

allowFrom.description: List of allowed email addresses that can interact with the bot. If not set, all users are allowed

requireMention.description: Require the bot to be mentioned (@botname) in group chats to respond

dmPolicy.description: Direct message policy: open (anyone), allowlist (allowFrom only), pairing (verified contacts), disabled
